title: SpiceXplorer circuit (super-DSL)
description: The canonical, tool-agnostic description of one abstract topology (plan D-3). Every consumer references this: the optimizer project_setup.yaml `extends:` it, netlist2tf reads the abstract netlist, the UI/agents read the capability flags.

kind.description: Circuit kind (D-9). Omitted == 'verifiable' (open-PDK, lowered, T1-T4). 'reference' == carries only foreign/proprietary reference bindings (see `references`); the harness runs a reference-only T0 subset and skips T1-T4.

id.description: snake_case scheme-centric topology id (D-8), e.g. amp_001_5t, nmcnr_3stage_ota.

class.description: Binds the class-scoped template/metric library under _shared/classes/<class>/ (D-10).

ports.description: Canonical port order; matches the abstract subckt header.

graph.description: path (relative to circuit dir) of the GENERATED cgraph.json

reference_schematic.description: path (relative to circuit dir) of an AUTHORED upstream reference schematic figure (e.g. the original AnalogGym/paper snapshot under reference/) — informational, never generated.

pdks.description: Open-PDK ids this topology lowers to (verifiable bindings); each must have a pdk/<id>/ directory. Optional for kind: reference circuits, which bind only via `references`.

references.description: Foreign/proprietary reference bindings (D-9) — authored decks in a non-open PDK/simulator, NOT lowered or run by the harness. Each entry points at a binding directory under the circuit holding dut/ (+ optional tb/, runs/).

dir.description: Binding directory relative to the circuit (e.g. spectre/28nm); contains dut/ and optionally tb/, runs/.

analyses.description: Analysis ids this circuit opts into; a subset of its class's templates.

optimize.description: Defaults the optimizer projection (project_setup.yaml) pulls via `extends:`.

status.description: DERIVED by the verify harness from the highest tier cleared (plan §6). Authored value is the floor. 'reference' is terminal for kind: reference circuits (they are never lowered/simulated here).
